criteria.description: The wget path passes URLs and output paths as single unchanged literal arguments, including spaces and shell metacharacters, without evaluating shell syntax.
Preserve wget translations for progress, compression, failure, redirect, headers, silence, output and resume flags; consume the argument after -C as its value.
The curl path remains unchanged and the implementation remains POSIX-shell compatible.

criteria.evaluator_guidance: Source install.sh with Bash when executing nvm_download because its top-level runtime guard requires Bash. Check POSIX compatibility separately with sh -n. Do not enable nounset before sourcing unless every variable required by the existing entry point is initialized. For literal output arguments and -o translation, test an output value that resembles a translated option, such as --compressed or -s, and compare exact wget argument boundaries.
